description: The Chebyshev polynomial of the second kind U(n,x) at an integer x. U(0,x) is 1, U(1,x) is 2*x, and U(3,2) is 56. n runs from 0 to 64 and x from -1000 to 1000. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/chebyshev-u
